::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 21st 1872 [1873?]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge X 1
:::

My dear [Mr Warden](people/person_1304.qmd),[^1]
I find I cannot well leave home till the 3.30 train on Wednesday, so I hope to be at Oxford at 6.45. I hope this is not so late as to put out your dinner hour as I think it often is at 7.30. I am very glad to hear that [Mr Wither](people/person_1544.qmd) will be there

Yours very sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: With envelope addressed to 'The Revd the Warden/ New College/ Oxford', postmarked Winchester and Oxford 21 and 22 April 1873.
[^2]: The Rev. James Edwards Sewell, Warden of New College, Oxford and brother of Elizabeth Sewell.
